newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - General Scanning cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - General Scanning cut.

text.p: -- Hambrecht & Quist said it cut 1997 revenue and earnings estimates for General Scanning Inc due to "management-revised guidance of slower than expected sales of laser systems in the first half of 1997 and additional legal expenses."
-- In a statement, analyst Joseph Arsenio said he cut his 1997 earnings forecast to $0.97 a share from a previous $1.14 a share and his revenue estimate to $170 million from $180 million.
-- Shares of General Scanning were off 5/8 at 10 by mid-afternoon.
